name: split-button
title: Split Button
description: Two HBD buttons joined into one visual unit: a wide primary ACTION half on the left and a narrow CHEVRON TRIGGER on the right. Clicking the action fires onAction; clicking the chevron opens a hand-ported dropdown menu of alternative actions (SplitButton.Item children or an items[] prop). The panel is an absolutely-positioned descendant so the legacy .hbd-split-button--open .hbd-split-button__panel rule drives the opacity/transform transition AND the chevron rotation 1:1. Controlled-first open + onOpenChange with defaultOpen fallback, roving menu keyboard nav (Escape/Tab/Enter/Space/Arrow/Home/End), capture-phase outside-click, and focus return to the trigger. Menu rows reuse the .hbd-field__option chrome. variant (default/primary/gold), size (sm/md/lg), disabled. role=menu/menuitem with aria-haspopup/expanded/controls/label.
